findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?registry=scriptmasterlabs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recommend_capability, list_playbooks, inspect_capability, x402_readiness, url_to_markdown, commit_discover_effects, read_capability, purchase_capability_read, aftersearch_verify_serp · Private data: list_playbooks, capability_manifest, x402_contract, commit_read_terms, execute_capability, purchase_capability_read, aftersearch_resolve, aftersearch_verify_serp · Public sink: commit_discover_effects, execute_capability, purchase_capability_read · Destructive: execute_capability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recommend_capability, list_playbooks, inspect_capability, x402_readiness, url_to_markdown, commit_discover_effects, read_capability, purchase_capability_read, aftersearch_verify_serp · Private data: list_playbooks, capability_manifest, x402_contract, commit_read_terms, execute_capability, purchase_capability_read, aftersearch_resolve, aftersearch_verify_serp · Public sink: commit_discover_effects, execute_capability, purchase_capability_read · Destructive: execute_capability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "agent_web_access" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "aftersearch_accept" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
